appearance_facts.fact: Single blue line with black circular markers, one marker per year from 2005 to 2014, monotonically non-increasing.
Line starts at the highest labeled value (23.9) at 2005 and ends at the lowest labeled value (10.1) at 2014.
Overall downward slope; each subsequent year's marker is at or below the prior year's marker.
Tick labels 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 visible; data points range from ~10.1 to ~23.9.
Year labels 2005 through 2014 in left-to-right order.
Bold title 'Reservoir Storage Level Index' at top-left.

public_definitions: Use the dashboard to determine whether the full-period reservoir storage change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
Routing criterion: Whether the full-period reservoir storage change requires substantial-change follow-up
Option: Route the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change to substantial-change follow-up
Option: Keep the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
Option: Route the reservoir storage record to archive and background filing
uncertain: No explicit numerical threshold for 'substantial-change' vs 'ordinary variation' is printed on the dashboard.
No legend or secondary series is present; only a single storage-index line is shown.
Units of 'Storage index' are not specified beyond the label.
